  Scenario: AC10 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given the caller holds the Decision log right
    When the caller calls GET /decision-log/{entryId} for an entry ID that is not stored
    Then the system answers with status 404
    Given the caller is not authenticated
    When the caller calls GET /decision-log/{entryId}
    Then the system answers with status 401

  Scenario: AC11 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an append of an entry is started in a transaction
    When the append activity fails transiently and is retried
    Then the entry is stored once, with one chain_seq
    When the append activity times out
    Then the system stores no entry and chain_seq is not used
